scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace api-nest && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api-nest && npm run lint --workspace mobile && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api-nest && npm run test --workspace mobile -- --runInBand
